chapters.title: When waking up

invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لله الذي أحيانا بَعْدَ ما أماتنا وإليه النشور.
invocations.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.
invocations.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.

invocations.context: The Prophet said: 'Whoever awakes at night and then says:
invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهو على كل شيء قدير، سُبْحانَ اللهِ، والحمدُ لله ، ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر ، ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم.
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.

invocations.context: ...and then supplicates:
invocations.arabic: رَبِّ اغفر لي.
invocations.translation: O my Lord forgive me.
invocations.post_context: Al-Waleed said, 'or he said: and then asks, he will be answered. If he then performs ablution and prays, his prayer will be accepted'.

invocations.arabic: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جَسَدِي وَرَدٌ عَليّ روحي وَأَذِنَ لي بذكره
invocations.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih.
invocations.translation: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.

invocations.instruction: Recite Verses 3:190-200 from Surah Ali Imran.
invocations.arabic: إنَّ فِي خَلْق السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْض واختلاف الليل والنهار لآيات لأولي الألباب ....
invocations.transliteration: Inna fee khalqi assamawati waal-ardi wa-ikhtilafi allayli wa-alnnahari la-ayatin li-olee al-albab...

chapters.title: Supplication when wearing a garment

invocations.arabic: الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا (الثوب) وَرَزَقْنيه مِنْ غَيْر حولٍ مني ولا قوة .
invocations.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.
invocations.translation: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.

chapters.title: Supplication said when wearing a new garment

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ له، وَأَعودُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah.
invocations.translation: O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it, I ask You for the good of it and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge with You from the evil of it and the evil for which it was made.

chapters.title: Supplication said to someone wearing a new garment

invocations.arabic: تبلي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
invocations.translation: May you wear it out and Allah replace it with another.
invocations.note: The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.

invocations.arabic: البس جديداً وَعِشْ حَميداً وَمُتْ شهيداً
invocations.transliteration: Ilbas jadeedan waAAish hameedan wamut shaheedan.
invocations.translation: Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed (martyr).

footnotes.definition: One who dies fighting the kuffar in order to make the word of Allah superior or in defense of Islam. It also has other meanings found in the Sunnah such as: the one who dies defending his life, wealth or family; the woman who passes away due to childbirth; one who drowns...etc.

chapters.title: Before undressing

invocations.arabic: بسم الله
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah.

chapters.title: Before entering the toilet

invocations.arabic: (بسم الله ) اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبْثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
invocations.transliteration: (Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith
invocations.translation: (In the name of Allah). O Allah, I take refuge with you from all evil and evil-doers.

chapters.title: After leaving the toilet

invocations.arabic: غفرانك
invocations.translation: I ask You (Allah) for forgiveness.

chapters.title: When starting ablution

invocations.arabic: بسم الله
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah.

chapters.title: Upon completing the ablution

invocations.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أن لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوله.
invocations.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh
invocations.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

invocations.arabic: اللهم اجعلني مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْني مِنَ المتطهرين.
invocations.translation: O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللهُمَّ وَبِحَمدِكَ أَشْهَدُ أن لا إله إلا أنتَ اسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ .
invocations.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
invocations.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.

chapters.title: When leaving the home

invocations.arabic: بسم الله ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ وَلَا حَولَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلا بالله
invocations.transliteration: Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

invocations.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك أنْ أضِلَّ أو أضل ، أو أزل أو أزل ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أظلم ، أو أجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay.
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You lest I should stray or be led astray, or slip or be tripped, or oppress or be oppressed, or behave foolishly or be treated foolishly.

footnotes.definition: i.e. to commit a sin unintentionally

chapters.title: Upon entering the home

invocations.arabic: بسم الله ولجنا ، وَبِسْمِ اللهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنا
invocations.transliteration: Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

chapters.title: Supplication when going to the mosque

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْ في قلبي نورا ، وفي لساني نورا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي سَمْعي نورا، وَاجْعَلْ في بصري نورا، وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ خَلفي نورا، وَمِنْ أمامي نورا، وَاجْعَلْ مِنْ فَوْقي نورا ، وَمِن تَحْتي نورا . اللهم أعطني نورا .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma ijAAal fee qalbee noora, wafee lisanee noora, wajAAal fee samAAee noora, wajAAal fee basaree noora, wajAAal min khalfee noora, wamin amamee noora, wajAAal min fawqee noora, wamin tahtee noora, allahumma aAAtinee noora.
invocations.translation: O Allah, place within my heart light, and upon my tongue light, and within my ears light, and within my eyes light, and place behind me light and in front of me light and above me light and beneath me light O Allah, bestow upon me light.

chapters.title: Upon entering the mosque

invocations.arabic: أعوذ بالله العظيم وبوجهه الكريم وسلطانه القديم مِنَ الشيطان الرجيم ، [ بسم الله، والصَّلاةُ] [وَالسَّلامُ عَلى رسول الله ، اللهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
invocations.transliteration: aAAoothu billahil-AAatheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah], allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.
invocations.translation: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.

chapters.title: Upon leaving the mosque

invocations.arabic: بسم الله والصلاة والسّلامُ عَلى رسول الله، اللهم إني أسألُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللهُمَّ اعصمني مِنَ الشَّيْطان الرجيم.
invocations.transliteration: Bismil-lah wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah, allahumma innee as-aluka min fadlik, allahumma iAAsimnee minash-shaytanir-rajeem.
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.

chapters.title: Supplications related to the athan

invocations.instruction: Repeat what the mu-aththin says, except when he says 'Hayya AAala s-salah' or 'hayya AAalal-falah', say:
invocations.arabic: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله.
invocations.transliteration: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah.
invocations.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

invocations.instruction: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin:
invocations.arabic: وأنا أشْهَدُ أنْ لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريك له ، وَأَنَّ محمّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُوله ، رضيتُ باللهِ رَبَّا ، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً وبالإسلام ديناً
invocations.transliteration: Wa-ana ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh, radeetu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil-islami deena.
invocations.translation: And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.

invocations.instruction: After answering the call of the mu-aththin:
invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَعْوَةِ التامة والصلاة القائمة آت محمَّداً الوسيلة والفضيلة وَابْعَثه مقاماً محموداً الَّذي وَعَدْتَه إِنَّكَ لا تُخْلِفُ الميعاد.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hathihid-daAAwatit-tammah, wassalatil-qa-imah ati Muhammadan alwaseelata wal-fadeelah, wabAAath-hu maqaman mahmoodan allathee waAAadtah, innaka la tukhliful-meeAAad.
invocations.translation: O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.

footnotes.definition: A station in paradise
A rank above the rest of creation
One in which all of creation will praise him on, in order to bring about the account quickly and be relieved from the lengthy standing or the role of intercession.

chapters.title: Supplication at the start of the prayer

invocations.arabic: اللهم باعد بيني وَبَيْنَ خَطاياي كما باعَدْتَ بَيْنَ المشرق والمَغْرِبُ ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ ، اللهُمَّ اغْسِلني مِنْ خَطاياي بالثلج والماءِ وَالْبَرَدْ .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma baAAid baynee wabayna khatayaya kama baAAadta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, allahumma naqqinee min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummagh-silnee min khatayaya biththalji walma-i walbarad.
invocations.translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.

invocations.arabic: سُبحانَكَ اللهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعالى جَدُّكَ وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
invocations.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika watabarakas-muka wataAAala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruk.
invocations.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

invocations.arabic: وَجَهتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذي فطر السمواتِ وَالْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًا وما أنا مِنَ المشركين ...
invocations.transliteration: Wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana minal-mushrikeen...
invocations.translation: I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ رَبَّ جبرائيل ، وميكائيل ، وَإسْرافيل، فاطِرَ السَّمواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israfeel fatiras-samawati walard...
invocations.translation: O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel...

invocations.arabic: الله أكبر كبيرا ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبيرا ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera...
invocations.translation: Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great...

invocations.instruction: When rising from sleep to perform prayers during the night:
invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أنْتَ ُنورُ السَّمواتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فيهن ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamd anta noorus-samawati wal-ardi waman feehin...
invocations.translation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the Earth...

footnotes.note: Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way. Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants...

footnotes.definition: Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills from amongst His creation just as He defers and holds back whom He wills in accordance to His wisdom. E.g. Favouring man over the rest of creation, favouring the Prophets over the rest of mankind...

chapters.title: While bowing in prayer (rukooAA)

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ رَبِّي العظيم .
invocations.translation: How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme (3 times).

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللهُمَّ رَبَّنا وَبِحَمْدِكَ ، اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي
invocations.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.

invocations.arabic: سبوح قدوس ، رَبُّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوح .
invocations.translation: Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وبك آمنت ، ولك أسلمت ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma laka rakaAAt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt...
invocations.translation: O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed...

invocations.arabic: سُبحان ذي الجبروت ، والملكوت ، والكبرياء ، والعظمه
invocations.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.

chapters.title: Upon rising from the bowing position

invocations.arabic: سمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَه .
invocations.translation: May Allah answer he who praises Him.

invocations.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلكَ الحَمْدُ حَمْداً كثيراً طيباً مباركاً فيه
invocations.transliteration: Rabbana walakal-hamdu hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh.
invocations.translation: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.

invocations.arabic: مِلْءَ السَّمواتِ وَمِلْءَ الْأَرْضِ ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُما ...
invocations.translation: The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises...

chapters.title: Supplication whilst prostrating

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ رَبِّي الأعلى .
invocations.translation: How perfect my Lord is, The Most High (3 times).

invocations.arabic: سُبحانَكَ اللهُمَّ رَبَّنا وَبِحَمْدِكَ ، اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي .
invocations.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord, and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.

invocations.arabic: سبوح قدوس، رَبُّ المَلائِكَةِ وَالرُّوح .
invocations.translation: Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh.

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبكَ آمنت ، ولك أسلمت ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma laka sajadt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt...
invocations.translation: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed...

invocations.arabic: سُبحان ذي الجبروت ، والملكوت ، والكبرياء ، والعظمه
invocations.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي ذنبي كله ، دِقَهُ وَجِلَه ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee thanbee kullah, diqqahu wajillah...
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins, the small and great of them...

invocations.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك مِنْ سَخَطِكَ ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure...

chapters.title: Supplication between the two prostrations

invocations.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي ، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي .
invocations.translation: My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ، وَارْحَمْنِي ، وَاهْدِنِي ، وَاجْبُرْنِي ، وَعافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي وَارْفَعْني
invocations.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee warfaAAnee.
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.

chapters.title: Supplication when prostrating due to recitation of the Quran

invocations.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهي للذي خَلَقَهُ وَصَوَّرَهُ وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ ...
invocations.transliteration: Sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu...
invocations.translation: My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing...

invocations.arabic: اللهم اكتب لي بها عِنْدَكَ أجْراً ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration)...

chapters.title: The Tashahhud

invocations.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ اللهِ وَالصَّلَواتُ والطَّيِّبات ...
invocations.translation: At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him...

footnotes.definition: what one says in the sitting position in prayer
all words which indicate the glorification of Allah. His eternal existence, His perfection and His sovereignty.

chapters.title: Prayers upon the Prophet after the tashahhud

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحمَّد، وَعَلى آل مُحمَّد...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad...
invocations.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the followers of Muhammad...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِه...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatihi...
invocations.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad...

footnotes.definition: praise and exalt him in the highest and superior of gatherings that of the closest angels to Allah.

footnotes.note: (al) has been translated in it's broadest sense: some scholars are of the view that the meaning here is more specific and that it means his followers from among his family.

chapters.title: Supplication said after the last tashahhud and before salam

invocations.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave...

invocations.arabic: اللهمَّ إِنِّي أعوذ بكَ مِنَ المَأْتَمِ وَالمَعْرَم .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma/thami walmaghram.
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي ظلمت نفسي ظلماً كثيراً ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee thalamtu nafsee thulman katheeran...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي ما قدَّمْتُ وَما أخرت ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee ma qaddamtu, wama akhkhart...
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass...

invocations.arabic: اللهم أعني على ذكرك وشكرك ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma aAAinnee AAala thikrik, washukrik, wahusni AAibadatik.
invocations.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best of manners.

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ البُخْل...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from miserliness...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألُكَ الجَنَّة وأعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النار .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar.
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبِ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلى الخَلق ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك يا الله بأنَّكَ الواحد الأحد ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka ya Allah bi-annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samad...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك بأنَّ لكَ الْحَمْدُ لا إله إلا أَنْتَ ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka bianna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa ant...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك بأنّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنتَ اللهُ ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma inne as-aluka biannee ashhadu annaka antallah...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah...

footnotes.definition: Among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind... He will appear from Asbahan, Iran... The word Kafir will be written between his eyes...
i.e. from Your innermost grace without deserving it...
Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills...
The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes...

chapters.title: Remembrance after salam

invocations.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ الله . (ثلاثا) اللهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلامُ ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلام ، تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام .
invocations.transliteration: Astaghfirullah (3 times). Allahumma antas-salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya thal-jalali wal-ikram.
invocations.translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness (3 times). O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد...
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah...

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له... لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله...
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah... la hawla wala quwwata illa billah...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah... There is no might nor power except with Allah...

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ اللهِ ، والحَمْدُ لله ، والله أكبر .
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest (33 times).

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهُوَ على كُلِّ شَيءٍ قدير
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner...

invocations.instruction: Recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas after each prayer.
Recite Ayat-Al-Kursiy after each prayer.
invocations.arabic: اللهُ لا إلهَ إلا هُوَ الحَيُّ القَيُّومُ ...
لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له... (10 times after Maghrib & Fajr)
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah...

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ علما نافعا ورزقاً طيباً ، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.

footnotes.definition: The One Who is free from all defects and deficiencies

chapters.title: Supplication for seeking guidance (Al-Istikharah)

invocations.context: On the authority of Jabir Ibn AAabdullah, he said: The Prophet would instruct us to pray for guidance...
invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أستخيرك بعلمك ، وَاسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee astakheeruka biAAilmik, wa-astaqdiruka bi qudratik...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge and by Your power...

footnotes.note: One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret.

chapters.title: Remembrance said in the morning and evening

invocations.arabic: أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسى الملك لله وَالحَمدُ لله ...
invocations.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty...

invocations.arabic: أصْبَحْنا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ الله
invocations.translation: We have reached the morning...

invocations.arabic: اللهم بك أصْبَحْنا وبك أمسينا ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning...

invocations.arabic: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant...
invocations.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أَشْهِدُك ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You...

invocations.arabic: اللهم ما أصْبَحَ بي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin...
invocations.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon...

invocations.arabic: اللهم عافني في بدني ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, grant my body health...

invocations.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذبك مِنَ الكفر ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief...

invocations.arabic: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هُوَ ...
invocations.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me...

invocations.arabic: أعوذ بكلمات الله التاماتِ مِنْ شَرِّ ما خلق .
invocations.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
invocations.translation: I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil He has created.

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أسألك العفو والعافية ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهادة ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen...

invocations.arabic: بسم الله الذي لا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسمِهِ شَيْءٌ ...
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed...

invocations.arabic: رَضيتُ باللهِ رَبَّاً وبالإسلام ديناً ...
invocations.translation: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord...

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ اللهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِه ...
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation...

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ .
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

invocations.arabic: يا حي يا قيوم بِرَحْمَتِكِ أستغيث ...
invocations.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth...
invocations.translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting... by Your mercy I seek assistance...

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ...
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah...

invocations.arabic: أَصْبَحْنا وَأَصْبَحْ المُلكُ للهِ رَبِّ العالمين ...
invocations.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah...

invocations.context: The messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever says in the morning:
invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد، وهُوَ على كُلِّ شَيءٍ قدير
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulk, walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

invocations.arabic: أصْبَحْنا على فِطْرَةِ الإسلام ...
invocations.translation: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam...

invocations.context: 'AAabdullah Ibn Khubaib said: 'The Messenger of Allah said to me 'Recite! ... Recite:
invocations.instruction: Recite Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas 3 times morning and evening.

footnotes.definition: after Fajr prayer until the sun rises
after AAsr prayer until the sunsets
the religion of Islam, the way of Ibraheem
the Shahada

chapters.title: Remembrance before sleeping

invocations.instruction: Spit in palms, recite last 3 chapters of Quran, wipe body (3 times).

invocations.context: The Prophet also said:
invocations.instruction: Recite Ayat-al-Kursee.

invocations.context: The Prophet also said:
invocations.instruction: Recite last two verses of Al-Baqarah.

invocations.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبي ...
invocations.translation: In Your name my Lord, I lie down...

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلقت نَفْسي وَأَنْتَ تَوَقاها ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha...
invocations.translation: O Allah, verily You have created my soul...

invocations.context: The Prophet would place his right hand under his cheek when about to sleep and supplicate:
invocations.arabic: اللهمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبادك .
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma qinee AAathabaka yawma tabAAathu AAibadak.
invocations.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment...

invocations.arabic: باسْمِكَ اللهُمَّ أموتُ وَأَحْيا .
invocations.translation: In Your name O Allah, I live and die.

invocations.context: When you go to bed say:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ الله ... الحمد لله ... الله أكبر
invocations.translation: How Perfect Allah is (33x), All praise is for Allah (33x), Allah is the greatest (34x).

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمواتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ العَرْش العظيم ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne...

invocations.arabic: الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي أطعمنا وسقانا...
invocations.translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ عالِم الغيب والشهادة ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, Knower of the seen and the unseen...

invocations.context: The Prophet never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah and Soorat Al-Mulk
invocations.instruction: Recite Soorat As-Sajdah and Al-Mulk.

invocations.context: If you take to your bed, then perform ablution... and then supplicate:
invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفسي إِلَيْكَ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I submit my soul unto You...

footnotes.definition: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle
The book revealed to Moosa
The book revealed to Easa
The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood
Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness...
Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets...

chapters.title: Supplication when turning over during the night

invocations.context: AAa-isha narrated that the Messenger of Allah used to say at night if he turned during sleep:
invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله الواحد القهار ...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar...

footnotes.definition: The One Who has subdued all of creation and Whom all of creation are subservient to.

chapters.title: Upon experiencing unrest, fear, apprehensiveness and the like during sleep

invocations.arabic: أعوذ بكلمات الله التاماتِ مِن غَضَبِهِ ...
invocations.translation: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger...

chapters.title: Upon seeing a good dream or a bad dream

invocations.context: The righteous dream is from Allah and the bad dream is from the devil...
invocations.instruction: Spit on your left 3 times, seek refuge in Allah from shaytan, do not relate it, turn over.

chapters.title: Qunoot Al-Witr

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْت...
invocations.translation: O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided...

invocations.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ برضاك مِنْ سَخَطِكَ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدْ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, it is You we worship...

footnotes.note: Allah does not create pure evil...

chapters.title: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer

invocations.context: ...after giving salam he would supplicate three times:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ المَلِكِ القدوس
invocations.translation: How perfect The King, The Holy One is.

invocations.context: ...on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add:
invocations.arabic: رب الملائكة والروح
invocations.translation: Lord of the angels and the Rooh.

chapters.title: Supplication for anxiety and sorrow

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَ الْحُزْن...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi wal huzn...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow...

chapters.title: Supplication for one in distress

invocations.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله العظيمُ الحَلِيم...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing...

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أرجو فلا تكلني إلى نفسي طرفة عين...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn...
invocations.translation: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for...

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا أنت سُبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمين.
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina th-thalimeen.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except You...

invocations.arabic: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّ لَا أَشْرِكْ بِهِ شَيْئاً.
invocations.transliteration: Allahu Allahu rabbi la oshriku bihi shaya.
invocations.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.

chapters.title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority

invocations.arabic: اللهم إنا نَجْعَلُكَ في نحورهم...
invocations.translation: O Allah, we place You before them...

invocations.arabic: اللهمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأنْتَ نَصيري...
invocations.translation: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper...

invocations.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوكيل.
invocations.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and how fine a trustee.

chapters.title: Supplication for one afflicted with doubt in his faith

invocations.context: He should seek refuge in Allah
He should say:
invocations.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ.
invocations.translation: I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.

invocations.context: He should also recite the following verse:
invocations.arabic: هو الأولُ، وَالآخِرُ، وَالظَّاهِرُ، وَالْباطِنُ...
invocations.transliteration: Huwa al-awwalu, wa al-akhiru, wa alththahiru wa albatinu...
invocations.translation: He is The First and The Last...

footnotes.definition: Indicates the greatness of His attributes...
Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets...

chapters.title: Settling a debt

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلالِكَ عَنْ حَرامِكَ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَمِّ وَ الْحُزْن...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi wal huzn...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow...

chapters.title: Supplication for one afflicted by whisperings in prayer or recitation

invocations.context: Othman Ibn Al-AAas narrated... The Messenger of Allah replied 'That is a devil called Khanzab, so if you sense his presence then seek refuge in Allah from him and spit on your left side three times.

chapters.title: Supplication for one whose affairs have become difficult

invocations.arabic: اللهم لا سهل إلا ما جَعَلْتَهُ سَهلا ...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla...
invocations.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy...

chapters.title: Upon committing a sin

invocations.context: Any servant who commits a sin and as a result, performs ablution, prays two units of prayer... and then seeks Allah's forgiveness, Allah would forgive him.

chapters.title: Supplication for expelling the devil and his whisperings

invocations.instruction: Seeking refuge from him.
The athan (call to prayer).
Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts...
invocations.note: Do not make your homes like the graveyards...

chapters.title: Supplication when stricken with a mishap or overtaken by an affair

invocations.context: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah... If a mishap should happen to befall you then do not say 'If only I had acted...'. Rather, say:
invocations.arabic: قدَّرَ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَل
invocations.translation: Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.

invocations.context: Indeed Allah rebukes negligence... but if a matter should overtake you then say:
invocations.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيل
invocations.translation: Allah is sufficient for me, and how fine a trustee.

chapters.title: Placing children under Allah's protection

invocations.context: Ibn AAabbas related that the Messenger of Allah used to commend Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn to Allah's protection, saying:
invocations.arabic: أعيدكما بكلمات الله التامة...
invocations.translation: I commend you two to the protection of Allah's perfect words...

chapters.title: When visiting the sick

invocations.context: When the Prophet would enter upon a sick person, he would say:
invocations.arabic: لا بأس طهور إنْ شَاءَ الله
invocations.translation: Never mind, may it (the sickness) be a purification, if Allah wills.

invocations.context: Any Muslim servant who visits a sick person... and supplicates seven times:
invocations.arabic: أَسْأَلُ الله العظيم، رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظيم أن يشفيك .
invocations.translation: I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you.

chapters.title: Excellence of visiting the sick

invocations.description: If a man calls on his sick Muslim brother, it is as if he walks reaping the fruits of Paradise...

chapters.title: Supplication of the sick who have renounced all hope of life

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لي وَارْحَمْنِي وَالحقني بالرفيق الأعلى
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the higher companions.

invocations.context: AAaishah related that the Prophet (during his illness...) would wipe his face and say:
invocations.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا الله، إِنَّ للمَوْتِ السكرات.
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, death does indeed contain agony.

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله والله أكبر...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest...

chapters.title: Instruction for the one nearing death

invocations.context: He whose last words are:
invocations.instruction: Encourage him to say the shahadah: La ilaha illal-lah.

chapters.title: Supplication for one afflicted by a calamity

invocations.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ راجعون ...
invocations.translation: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return...

chapters.title: When closing the eyes of the deceased

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لفلان باسمه ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive (name)...

footnotes.definition: One who succeeds another due to the latter's absence or death...

chapters.title: Supplication for the deceased at the funeral prayer

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنا وَمَيِّتِنا ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead...

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلانَ بْنَ فلان في ذِمَّتِكَ ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care...

invocations.arabic: اللهُم عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant...

chapters.title: Supplication for the advancement of reward during the funeral prayer

invocations.context: This supplication is made when the deceased is a baby/child
invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وذخراً لوالديه...
invocations.translation: O Allah, make him a preceding reward and a stored treasure for his parents...

invocations.context: Al-Hasan used to recite the opening chapter... and then supplicates:
invocations.arabic: اللهم اجعله لنا فرطا، وسلفا وأجْراً.
invocations.translation: O Allah, make him a preceding reward, a prepayment and a recompense for us.

chapters.title: Condolence

invocations.arabic: إِنَّ الله ما أخذ وله ما أعطى...
invocations.transliteration: Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta...
invocations.translation: Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave...

invocations.context: ...and one can also say:
invocations.arabic: أعظم اللهُ أَجْرَك ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَ كَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ.
invocations.transliteration: aAAthamal-lahu ajrak, wa-ahsana AAazaak, waghafara limayyitik.
invocations.translation: May Allah magnify your reward, make better your solace and forgive your deceased.

chapters.title: Placing the deceased in the grave

invocations.arabic: بسم اللهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسول الله .
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

chapters.title: After burying the deceased

invocations.context: After the Prophet would bury the deceased he would stand by the grave and say:
invocations.instruction: Seek forgiveness for your brother and pray that he remains firm.

chapters.title: Visiting the graves

invocations.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيارِ مِنَ المُؤمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِين...
invocations.translation: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves...

chapters.title: Prayer said during a wind storm

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَها ، وأعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّها.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it's goodness and I take refuge with You from it's evil.

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَها ، وَخَيْرَ ما فيها...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it's goodness, the good within it...

chapters.title: Supplication upon hearing thunder

invocations.context: When AAabdullah Ibn Az-Zubayr used to hear thunder he would stop talking and say:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ الَّذي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ، وَالملائكة من خيفته.
invocations.transliteration: Subhanal-lathee yusabbihur-raAAdu bihamdih, walmala-ikatu min kheefatih.
invocations.translation: How perfect He is, (The One) Whom the thunder declares His perfection with His praise...

chapters.title: Supplication for rain

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ اسْقِنا غَيْثا مغيثاً مريئاً مريعاً...
invocations.translation: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain...

invocations.arabic: اللهم أغثنا، اللهُمَّ أَغِثنا، اللهم أغثنا.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna, allahumma aghithna.
invocations.translation: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقَ عِبادَكَ وَبَهَائِمَكَ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle...

chapters.title: Supplication said when it rains

invocations.arabic: اللهمَّ صَيِّباً نافعاً
invocations.translation: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain cloud.

chapters.title: After rainfall

invocations.arabic: مطرنا بفضل اللهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ.
invocations.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

chapters.title: Asking for clear skies

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنا...
invocations.translation: O Allah, let the rain fall around us and not upon us...

chapters.title: Upon sighting the crescent moon

invocations.arabic: الله أكبر، اللهُمَّ أهْلَهُ عَلَيْنا بالأمن والإيمان...
invocations.transliteration: Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman...
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace...

chapters.title: Upon breaking fast

invocations.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَا، وَابْتَلَتِ العُروق...
invocations.translation: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched...

invocations.context: AAabdullah Ibn AAamr Ibn Al-AAas related that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Indeed the fasting person has at the time of breaking fast, a supplication which is not rejected'.

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ التي وَسِعَت كُلَّ شيء...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things...

chapters.title: Supplication before eating

invocations.context: When you are about to eat, you should say:
invocations.arabic: بسم الله
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah.

invocations.context: ...and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say:
invocations.arabic: بسم اللهِ في أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِره .
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah in it's beginning and end.

invocations.context: Whomever Allah feeds, should say:
invocations.arabic: اللهم بارك لنا فيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْه.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.
invocations.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.

invocations.context: ....and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:
invocations.arabic: اللهم بارك لنا فيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْه.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.
invocations.translation: O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.

chapters.title: Upon completing the meal

invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذي أطعمني هذا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ ...
invocations.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me...

invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً كثيراً طيباً مباركا فيه...
invocations.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh...
invocations.translation: Allah be praised with an abundant beautiful blessed praise...

chapters.title: Supplication of the guest for the host

invocations.arabic: اللهم بارك لهُمْ فيما رَزَقْتَهُم ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.
invocations.translation: O Allah, bless for them, that which You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy upon them.

chapters.title: Supplication said to one offering a drink

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ أَطْعِم مَن أطعمني، وَاسْق من سقاني.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee.
invocations.translation: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.

chapters.title: Supplication said when breaking fast in someone's home

invocations.arabic: أقطر عندكم الصائمون وأكل طعامكم الأبرار ، وصلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ المَلائِكَة.
invocations.transliteration: Aftara AAindakumus-sa-imoon, wa-akala taAAamakumul-abrar, wasallat AAalaykumul-mala-ikah.
invocations.translation: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.

chapters.title: Supplication said by one fasting when presented with food

invocations.instruction: If you are not invited then answer. If you are fasting then supplicate; if not then eat.

chapters.title: Supplication said upon seeing the early or premature fruit

invocations.arabic: اللهم بارك لنا في تمرنا، وبارك لنا في مدينتنا...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina...
invocations.translation: O Allah, bless our fruit for us, bless our town for us...

footnotes.definition: A saAA is equivalent to four mudds and a mudd is equivalent to a dry measure of an average man's two palms.

chapters.title: Supplication said upon sneezing

invocations.context: When one of you sneezes he should say:
invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ.
invocations.translation: All praise if for Allah.

invocations.context: ...and his brother or companion should say to him:
invocations.arabic: يَرْحَمُكَ الله.
invocations.translation: May Allah have mercy upon you.

invocations.context: ...and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:
invocations.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بالكم.
invocations.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

chapters.title: Supplication said to the newlywed

invocations.arabic: بارك الله لك، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُما فِي خَيْرٍ
invocations.transliteration: Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.
invocations.translation: May Allah bless for you (your spouse) and bless you, and may He unite both of you in goodness.

chapters.title: The groom's supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

invocations.context: when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:
invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَها، وَخَيْرَ ما جَبَلْتَها عَلَيْه...
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh...
invocations.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards...

chapters.title: Supplication before sexual intercourse

invocations.arabic: بسم الله اللهُمَّ جَنَّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنْبِ الشَّيْطَانَ ما رزقتنا.
invocations.transliteration: Bismil-lah, allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wajannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep the devil away from us and keep the devil away from what you have blessed us with.

chapters.title: When angry

invocations.arabic: أعوذُ باللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطانِ الرَّحِيم
invocations.translation: I take refuge with Allah from the accursed devil.

chapters.title: Supplication said upon seeing someone in trial or tribulation

invocations.context: This supplication is to be said to one's self, not directly to the one in trial or tribulation.
invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لله الذي عافاني مِمَّا ابْتَلاكَ به...
invocations.translation: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with...

chapters.title: Remembrance said at a sitting or gathering

invocations.context: Ibn AAumar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah would say one hundred times at any one sitting before getting up:
invocations.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لي، وتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الغَفور.
invocations.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.
invocations.translation: O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me. Verily You are The Oft-Returning. The Oft-Forgiving.

chapters.title: Supplication for the expiation of sins said at the conclusion of a sitting

invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللهُمَّ وَبِحَمدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أن لا إله إلا أنتَ ...
invocations.transliteration: Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant...
invocations.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You...

invocations.context: AAaishah said: Whenever The Messenger of Allah would betake a seat, read Quran or pray, he would always conclude it with certain words...
invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَكَ وَيَحَمدِك، لا إله إلا أنتَ أسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
invocations.transliteration: Subhanaka wabi hamdik, la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa -atoobu ilayk.
invocations.translation: How perfect You are and I praise You None has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You

chapters.title: Returning a supplication of forgiveness

invocations.context: AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis said: 'I went to see the Prophet and ate from his food and then said to him:
invocations.arabic: غَفَرَ اللهُ لكَ يا رسول الله.
invocations.translation: May Allah forgive you, O Messenger of Allah.

invocations.context: ...he replied:
invocations.arabic: ولك .
invocations.translation: and you.

chapters.title: Supplication said to one who does you a favour

invocations.context: If someone does you a favour and you say:
invocations.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً.
invocations.translation: May Allah reward you with goodness.

chapters.title: Protection from the Dajjal

invocations.instruction: Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.
One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.

footnotes.definition: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind... He will appear from Asbahan, Iran...

chapters.title: Supplication said to one who pronounces his love for you, for Allah's sake

invocations.arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الذي أَحْبَبْتَني له.
invocations.translation: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.

chapters.title: Supplication said to one who has offered you some of his wealth

invocations.arabic: بارك اللهُ لكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِك.
invocations.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.

chapters.title: Supplication said to the debtor when his debt is settled

invocations.arabic: بارك اللهُ لكَ في أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِك، إنَّما جَزاءُ السَّلفِ الْحَمْدُ والأداء.
invocations.transliteration: Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada.
invocations.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.

chapters.title: Supplication for fear of shirk

invocations.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذبك أن أشرك بك وأنا أعْلَمْ، وَاسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِما لا أعلم.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam.
invocations.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.

footnotes.definition: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him...

chapters.title: Returning a supplication after having bestowed a gift

invocations.context: AAaishah reported that... When the servant would come back... he replied: They would supplicate:
invocations.arabic: بارك الله فيكم.
invocations.translation: May Allah bless you all.

invocations.context: ...AAaishah would then say:
invocations.arabic: وفيهم بارك الله.
invocations.translation: and may Allah bless them.

chapters.title: Forbiddance of ascribing things to omens

invocations.context: This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil... but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says:
invocations.arabic: اللهم لا طير إلا طيرك، ولا خَيْرَ إلا خَيْرُكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.
invocations.translation: O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.

chapters.title: Supplication said when mounting an animal or any means of transport

invocations.arabic: بسْمِ اللهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لله، سُبْحانَ الَّذي سَخَّرَ لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لمنقلبون، الحَمْدُ لله، الحَمْدُ لله، الحَمْدُ لله، الله أكبر، الله أكبر ، اللهُ أَكْبَر، سُبْحَانَكَ اللهُمَّ إنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفسي فَاغْفِرْ لي فَإِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوب إلا أنت.
invocations.transliteration: Bismil-lah, walhamdu lillah, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanakal-lahumma innee thalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fainnahu la yaghfiru th-thunooba illa ant.
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.

chapters.title: Supplication for travel

invocations.arabic: الله أكبر ، الله أكبر ، الله أكبر ، سُبْحانَ الَّذي سَخَّرَ لنا هذا وما كُنَّا لَهُ مُقرنين...
invocations.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha...
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is...

invocations.arabic: آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون
invocations.translation: We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.

footnotes.definition: Two comprehensive terms which individually, refer to all good actions and obedience...
one who succeeds another due to the latter's absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah...

chapters.title: Supplication upon entering a town or village

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمواتِ السَّبْع وما أظللن ...
invocations.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop...

chapters.title: When entering the market

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك وله الحمد ...
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner...

chapters.title: Supplication for when the mounted animal stumbles

invocations.arabic: بسم الله .
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah.

chapters.title: Supplication of the traveller for the resident

invocations.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذي لا تَضيعُ وَدَائِعُه.
invocations.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.

chapters.title: Supplication of the resident for the traveller

invocations.arabic: أسْتَوْدِعُ اللهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمانَتَكَ، وَخَواتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ.
invocations.transliteration: AstawdiAAul-laha deenak, wa amanatak, wakhawateema AAamalik.
invocations.translation: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.

invocations.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللهُ التقوى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْتُمَا كُنت.
invocations.transliteration: Zawwadakal-lahut-taqwa, waghafara thanbak, wayassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunt.
invocations.translation: May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.

footnotes.definition: a comprehensive term which refers to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions

chapters.title: Remembrance while ascending or descending

invocations.context: Jabir said: While ascending, we would say:
invocations.arabic: الله أكبر .
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest.

invocations.context: ...and when descending, we would say:
invocations.arabic: سُبحان الله .
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is.

chapters.title: Prayer of the traveller as dawn approaches

invocations.arabic: سَمِعَ سَامِعُ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْن بَلائِهِ عَلَيْنا...
invocations.transliteration: SamiAAa samiAAun bihamdil-lahi wahusni bala-ihi AAalayna...
invocations.translation: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours...

chapters.title: Stopping or lodging somewhere

invocations.arabic: أعوذ بكلماتِ الله التاماتِ مِنْ شَرِّ ما خلق.
invocations.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
invocations.translation: I take refuge in Allah's perfect words from the evil that He has created.

chapters.title: While returning from travel

invocations.context: Ibn AAumar reported that the Messenger of Allah... would say at every high point:
invocations.arabic: الله أكبر، اللهُ أَكْبَر، اللهُ أَكْبَر.
invocations.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.

invocations.context: ...and then he would say:
invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له... آيبون تائبون...
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah... ayiboona ta-iboon...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah... We return, repent...

chapters.title: What to say upon receiving pleasing or displeasing news

invocations.context: When he used to receive pleasant news, he would say:
invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحات
invocations.translation: All Praise is for Allah by whose favour good works are accomplished.

invocations.context: ...and upon receiving displeasing news, he would say:
invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ اللهِ على كل حال.
invocations.translation: All Praise is for Allah in all circumstances.

chapters.title: Excellence of sending prayers upon the Prophet

invocations.description: Whoever sends a prayer upon me, Allah sends ten upon him.
Send prayers upon me, for verily your prayers reach me wherever you are.
A miser is one whom when I am mentioned to him, fails to send prayers upon me.

chapters.title: Excellence of spreading the Islamic greeting

invocations.description: Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.
Feed (the poor), and greet those whom you know as well as those whom you do not.

chapters.title: Supplication said upon hearing a rooster crow or the braying of an ass

invocations.instruction: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty. If you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah.

chapters.title: Supplication upon hearing the barking of dogs at night

invocations.instruction: Seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.

chapters.title: Supplication said for one you have insulted

invocations.arabic: اللهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُربة إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma fa-ayyuma mu/minin sababtuhu fajAAal thalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah.
invocations.translation: O Allah, to any believer whom I have insulted, let that be cause to draw him near to You on the Day of Resurrection.

chapters.title: The etiquette of praising a fellow Muslim

invocations.instruction: Say: I deem so-and-so to be... and Allah is his reckoner...

chapters.title: Supplication said between the Yemeni corner and the black stone

invocations.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
invocations.transliteration: Rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhirati hasanatan waqina AAathaba alnnar
invocations.translation: O our Lord, grant us the best in this life and the best in the next life, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

chapters.title: Supplication said when at Mount Safa & Mount Marwah

invocations.context: Jabir said... '...and when he approached mount Safa he recited:
invocations.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا والمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شعائر الله .... أَبْدَأَ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ.
invocations.transliteration: Innas-safa wa-almarwata min shaAAa-iri Allah.... Abda-o bima badaal-lahu bih.
invocations.translation: Indeed Safa and Marwah are from the places of worship of Allah... I begin with what Allah began with.

invocations.context: ...so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the KaAAbah, he then faced it and said:
invocations.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
invocations.transliteration: Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest.

invocations.context: ...and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time:
invocations.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك ولهُ الحَمْدُ وهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ...
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd...
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner...

chapters.title: The Day of AAarafah

invocations.context: 'The best of supplications is the supplication on the day of AAarafah and the best which I and the Prophets before me have said (is):
invocations.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty and He is over all things omnipotent.

chapters.title: At the Sacred Site (Al-MashAAar Al-Haram)

invocations.instruction: Face the qiblah, supplicate to Allah, and extol His greatness and oneness.

footnotes.definition: The name of the Prophet's camel.

chapters.title: When throwing each pebble at the Jamarat

invocations.context: Every time the Prophet threw a pebble at any of the three jamarat, he would say:
invocations.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ.
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest.

chapters.title: At the black stone

invocations.context: The Prophet circled the KaAAbah on a camel, every time he reached the black stone he would point to it with his staff and say:
invocations.arabic: اللهُ أَكْبَرُ.
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest.

chapters.title: Supplication made against an enemy

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الكِتَابِ سَريعَ الحِسابِ اهْزِمَ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمُهُمْ وَزَلْزِلَهُمْ.
invocations.transliteration: Allahumma munzilal kitab, sareeAAal-hisab, ihzimil-ahzab, allahummah-zimhum wazalzilhum.
invocations.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.

chapters.title: What to say when in fear of a people

invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ.
invocations.translation: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.

chapters.title: What to say at times of amazement and delight

invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ !
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is.

invocations.arabic: الله أكبر !
invocations.translation: Allah is the greatest.

chapters.title: What to do upon receiving pleasant news

invocations.instruction: The Prophet would prostrate in gratitude to Allah.

chapters.title: What to say and do when feeling some pain in the body

invocations.context: Place your hand at the site of the pain and say:
invocations.arabic: بسم الله (ثلاثا)
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah (three times).

invocations.context: ...the supplicate seven times:
invocations.arabic: أعُودُ بِاللهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مَنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأَحَاذِرُ. (سبع مرات)
invocations.transliteration: aAAoothu billahi waqudratih min sharri ma ajidu wa-ohathir. (seven times).
invocations.translation: I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.

chapters.title: What to say when in fear of afflicting something or someone with ones eye

invocations.context: From the supplications for the protection against the Evil Eye:
invocations.arabic: اللهم بارك عليه.
invocations.translation: O Allah, send blessing upon him.

invocations.arabic: ما شاء الله، لا قُوَّةَ إلا بالله.
invocations.transliteration: Ma shaal-lah, la quwwata illa billah.
invocations.translation: (this is) that which Allah has willed, there is no power except with Allah.

invocations.context: If you see something from your brother, yourself or wealth which you find impressing, then invoke blessings for it...

footnotes.definition: To look at something and be impressed with it, causing harm to befall it. This 'looking' may or may not involve jealousy...

chapters.title: Etiquette of retiring for the night

invocations.instruction: Restrain children at Maghrib, shut doors, tie water-skins, cover vessels, put out lamps, mentioning Allah's name.

chapters.title: The Talbiyah

invocations.arabic: لبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لا شَريكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ...
invocations.transliteration: Labbaykal-lahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk...
invocations.translation: Here I am O Allah, here I am...

chapters.title: What to say when startled

invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

chapters.title: What is said to a Kafir when he sneezes

invocations.arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.
invocations.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.

chapters.title: Returning a greeting to a Kafir

invocations.context: When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying:
invocations.arabic: وعليكم.
invocations.translation: And upon you.

chapters.title: When insulted while fasting

invocations.arabic: إنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ.
invocations.translation: I am fasting, I am fasting.

chapters.title: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice

invocations.arabic: بسم الله واللهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي.
invocations.transliteration: Bismil-lah wallahu akbar, allahumma minka walak, allahumma taqabbal minnee
invocations.translation: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.

chapters.title: What is said to ward off the deception of the Obstinate Shaytans

invocations.arabic: أَعُودُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ ولا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ...
invocations.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat, allatee la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajir min sharri ma khalaq...
invocations.translation: I take refuge within Allah's perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress...

chapters.title: Seeking forgiveness and repentance

invocations.description: I seek forgiveness and repent to Allah, more than seventy times a day.

invocations.context: He also said: 'Whoever says:
invocations.arabic: اسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ الَّذِي لا إلهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأتُوبُ إِلَيهِ.
invocations.transliteration: Astaghfirul-lahal-lathee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa-atoobu ilayh.
invocations.translation: I seek Allah's forgiveness, besides whom, none has the right to be worshipped except He, The Ever Living, The Self-Subsisting... and I turn to Him in repentance.

invocations.description: The nearest the Lord comes to His servant is in the middle of the night...

invocations.context: He also said: 'verily my heart becomes preoccupied...

footnotes.definition: i.e. in a state of 'forgetfulness'. The Prophet always used to increase in his remembrance of his Lord...

chapters.title: Excellence of remembrance and glorification of Allah

invocations.context: Whoever says... a hundred times during the day:
invocations.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شريك له، له الملك ولهُ الحَمْد، وهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيءٍ قدير. (مائة مرة).
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer (one hundred times)
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise...

invocations.context: Whoever says... a hundred times during the day:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ. مائة مرة في اليوم)
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

invocations.context: Whoever says at morning and evening time:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ وبِحَمْدِهِ حين يصبح وحين يمسي)
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.

invocations.context: Aboo Ayyoob Al-Ansaree related that The Prophet said: 'Whoever says:
invocations.arabic: لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لهُ، لهُ المُلكُ ولهُ الحَمْدُ وهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partener. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.

invocations.context: Aboo Hurayrah reported... '(There are) Two words, (which are) light on the tongue...
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ وَسُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيم.
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him. How perfect Allah is, The Supreme.

invocations.context: Aboo Hurayrah reported that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Saying:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ لله، لا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
invocations.transliteration: Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar.
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest.

invocations.context: Sa'd said... 'Are any of you unable to gain a thousand good deeds each day?'... 'He should say:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ.
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is.

invocations.context: Jabbir related that the Prophet said: 'Whoever says:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ العَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is. The Supreme, and I praise Him.

invocations.context: AAabdullah Ibn Qays related... 'O 'AAabdullah Ibn Qays, shall I not inform you of a treasure from the treasures of paradise?' He then said: 'Say:
invocations.arabic: لا حولَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ.
invocations.transliteration: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah.
invocations.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.

invocations.context: the most beloved words to Allah are four:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ للهِ ، ولا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
invocations.transliteration: Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.

invocations.context: SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah and said to him: 'Teach me something which I should say?' He said: 'Say:
invocations.arabic: لا إلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَريكَ لهُ، الله أكبر كبيرا والحَمْدُ لله كثيراً، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العالمين، لا حَولَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلا بالله العزيز الحكيم.
invocations.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, subhanal-lahi rabbil-AAalameen, la hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAazeezil-hakeem.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner. Allah is most great and much praise is for Allah...

invocations.context: ...the man then said: 'These are for my Lord, and what is for me?' He replied: 'Say:
invocations.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ، وارْحَمْنِي، واهْدِنِي، وارزقني.
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me and grant me sustenance

invocations.context: Tariq Al-AshjaAAee said: 'When someone would embrace Islam, the Prophet would teach him how to perform prayer and then order him to supplicate with the following words:
invocations.arabic: اللهم اغفر لي، وارْحَمْنِي، واهْدِنِي، وعَافِنِي وارزقني.
invocations.transliteration: Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, waAAafinee warzuqnee
invocations.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, give me health and grant me sustenance.

invocations.context: Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah related that the Messenger of Allah said: 'Verily, the best supplication is:
invocations.arabic: الْحَمْدُ للهِ.
invocations.translation: All praise is for Allah.

invocations.context: ...and indeed, the best form of remembrance is:
invocations.arabic: لا إله إلا الله.
invocations.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

invocations.context: 'The everlasting righteous deeds:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ، والحَمْدُ لله، لا إلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ واللهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلا حَولَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ.
invocations.transliteration: Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.
invocations.translation: How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, and Allah is the greatest. There is no might nor power except with Allah.

footnotes.definition: after prayer until the sunrises
after AAsr prayer until the sunsets, however some scholars say after the sunsets and onwards.

chapters.title: How the prophet made tasbeeh

invocations.context: Tasbeeh, it means here, to say:
invocations.arabic: سُبْحانَ الله، الحَمْدُ لله، اللهُ أَكْبَر.

invocations.description: AAabdullah Ibn AAamr said: 'I saw the prophet make tasbeeh with his right hand.

book_conclusion.text: O Allah, send peace and blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad, his companions, and his family and all those who follow them in righteousness till the Day of Reckoning. Ameen.
